dine-in.description: Dine-in KOT: --panel with --hair2 border, table, waiter, order number, elapsed timer.

takeaway.description: Takeaway KOT: --ac-t background and --ac-b border; no "Table" label.

cancelled.description: Cancelled KOT: --rd-t / --rd-b, "( Cancelled )" after the order number, [Old Qty = n] per item and disposition buttons Return to Stock (--gr) and Mark as Wasted (--rd).

partially-cancelled.description: Partially cancelled: same red treatment, disposition pending on the cancelled item only.

disposition-resolved.description: Disposition resolved: the buttons are replaced by "( Disposition: Returned to Stock )".

duplicate.description: Duplicate KOT: red note "Duplicate KOT ( CHECK WITH CAPTAIN )" under the header.

aggregator.description: Aggregator order: Aggregator and Aggregator ID rows under the header, takeaway colours.

struck-item.description: Item tapped as done: line-through in --gr.

overdue.description: Elapsed time past kot_alert_time: timer turns --rd.

comments.description: KOT comment line and an item comment.

flip-serve.description: Card tapped: overlay (inset 0, opacity .9, --panel) with a Serve button.

flip-confirm.description: Cancelled card tapped: the overlay button reads Confirm.
